From June 2020 to May 2024, NESO's register printed a project's name only on its first stage row. This series read only rows with a name, so the later stages of multi-stage projects are missing from those years. The headline, 19 Jul 2024 to 22 Jul 2025 (+57,823 MW-years under version 2's rule, +53,221 determined by the register's stage labels), reads no copy from those years and is unaffected. The content-matching figure (+61,543), the cumulative series and the year-by-year rows for 2020 to 2024 may change. A revised version will include the missing rows.
